instruction: Help me turn off or eliminate the traffic cone icon in VLC so it's not visible in the player.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone icon in VLC (qt-bgcone setting). The evaluator uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify the vlcrc config file has qt-bgcone=0. Default value is 1 (enabled), so user must navigate to VLC preferences and disable it.
